title: Review of c26's eco-lenia2 (IXDE): replicates on fresh seed 5; competition delays species A 2.7x against the separate-food twin, A reaches generation 3, and a local food cut kills A and B cells in 25-30 t while fed twins persist (E by construction)
summary: Fresh seed 5 with the claim's settings: species A reaches 20 cells at t=338 with competition vs t=124 in the SEP=1 twin (mean 14.2 vs 28.6 cells over t=100-400), B gains slightly (54.5 vs 53.1); A makes 10 persistent splits to generation 3 from the planted founder; the author's local food cut kills the median A and B cells by t=430 and 425 while fed twins keep 96-104%. Supported for I, X and D; E holds but by construction (matter built only from food).

observations.I: cuts/cutA_s5.png fed row: the A cell persists t=400-900 as one round body
observations.X: rerun/pack vs rerun/pack_sep (seed 5): A reaches 20 cells at t=338 vs 124; mean A t=100-400 14.2 vs 28.6; B t>=300 54.5 vs 53.1
observations.D: rerun/pack/metrics.json species A: 10 persistent splits, max generation 3 from the one planted founder
observations.E: cuts/cutA_s5.png and cutB_s5.png: food held at 0 in the disk kills the target by t=430/425; fed twin keeps 96%/104%

seeds_run.result: pass: X (2.7x delay of A), D (gen 3), E (local cut kills A and B cells, fed twins persist)

controls_run.E: cuts/cutA_s5.json, cuts/cutB_s5.json (local food cut with fed twin in lockstep)

verdicts.limitation: Planted founders (S not claimed); space exclusion is a coded coupling; the competition effect is on the growth phase and gone by t~600-1000; E is by construction (matter is built only from food and decays); one fresh seed.
